meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:
Bilkul 😊 India mein online **women’s kurta sets** ke liye main in brands ko shortlist karungi:

- **BIBA** — quality + classic Indian look. Daily wear se festive tak achhi variety; cotton sets especially practical hain. [www.biba.in](https://www.biba.in/kurta-sets/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
  ### [Biba Women's Floral Print Straight Kurta Set]()
*₹2,159*

- **W for Woman** — agar **office/working-woman look** chahiye. Designs polished, contemporary aur relatively sophisticated lagte hain. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

- **Libas** — **budget-friendly + trendy**. Prints, straight sets, palazzos aur dupatta sets mein kaafi options milte hain. [www.indisangam.com](https://www.indisangam.com/blogs/news/best-kurta-set-brands-in-india?utm_source=chatgpt.com)  
  ### [Libas Pink Embroidered Straight Suit Set with Dupatta]()
*₹1,879*

- **Aurelia** — **comfortable everyday wear**, especially cotton/relaxed silhouettes ke liye. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378-amp.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

- **Rangriti** — **affordable casual ethnicwear**, especially agar ₹500–₹1,500 ke aas-paas mein options chahiye.

**Meri quick ranking:**  
👩‍💼 Office → **W**  
🌸 Daily wear → **BIBA / Aurelia**  
💰 Budget + trendy → **Libas / Rangriti**  
✨ Festive → **BIBA / W**

Agar tum mujhe **budget (e.g. ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000)** aur **occasion (office/daily/festive/wedding)** bata do, main tumhare liye **5–10 specific kurta sets** shortlist kar sakti hoon.
